$comment: #913 canonical opening Helsinki location graph. Only Home and Ratakatu HQ are initially visible. Explicit story knowledge flags reveal all other places; no speculative buildings in map art. Fictional establishments and agency jurisdiction. `position` is normalized 0..1 on the map panel: x east, y south. Kallio/Sörnäinen sits north-east, Punavuori south, the university in the centre. The underground shares HQ's latitude because it is beneath it, and must not be drawn until clearance.

nodes.name: Home · Helsinginkatu
nodes.description: Yesterday you moved into a modest UNSA-provided flat on Helsinginkatu. Unpacked boxes, passing trams, cheap bars and an uneasy meeting of old working-class and new bohemian Helsinki.

nodes.name: UNSA Helsinki Field Office · Ratakatu
nodes.description: Former Suojelupoliisi office. Above ground: bland, friendly Nordic UNSA branding and bewildering Supo/Europol/UNSA badge jurisdictions. Rookies alone must wear the absurd new uniform.

nodes.name: Olutravintola Putki
nodes.description: Romppainen's beloved academic and underground bar. Students, intellectuals, anarchists, migrants and artists trade ideas, gossip and leads.

nodes.name: University of Helsinki
nodes.description: An ordinary Helsinki university, useful for scholarly contacts, expert interviews, archives and investigation.

nodes.name: Kurvi
nodes.description: Bohemian crossroads of trams, nightlife, working-class memory and changing Helsinki street culture.

nodes.name: Ö-Mappi underground complex
nodes.description: Hidden UNSA/Supo installation with subterranean institutional layers dating back to circa 1920.
